points: The chapter jumps back in time to Paroh Nekho, and describes his downfall and then the downfall of all of Egypt.
The Radak: it is justice for Egypt killing Yoshiyahu, the great reformer. The Malbim: justice for Egypt not helping us against Nevuchadnetzar.
Egypt starts out like the overflowing Nile and ends up like a snake that can barely move. Trusting in a superpower doesn't bring safety; Hashem runs the world.
The main message is at the end: "Al tira avdi Yaakov." Don't be afraid, Hashem is with you even in exile.
Great empires will fall and be destroyed. The Jewish people will be punished, but never wiped out, and will be brought back.
